# Cited Photo Archive Registry — Photo Registry 232 (CultureTechLens)

 > The registry of CultureTechLens' 232 published Cited Photo Archive evidence cards: per photo, registry ID, title, photographer, source, rights statement, what it documents, the citation as published, page/file URLs, and an AEO question and answer. All 232 rows are rights-stated (119 public domain; the rest CC and CC0); none uncleared. Extracted verbatim from culturetechlens.com/photos/ on 2026-11-04 and governed by CTL-PHOTO-001/002. Distinct from the internal Photo Rights Log v4 — the two are never merged.

## Sample cards
- **Angel Reese, Chicago Sky, 2024** — Photo: Alexander Jonesi (Wikimedia Commons; CC BY-SA 2.0). Angel Reese photographed during her Chicago Sky rookie season, 2024.
- **Vice President Kamala Harris — official portrait, 2021** — Photo: Lawrence Jackson, The White House (Wikimedia Commons; Public domain). The official portrait of Vice President Kamala Harris, March 5, 2021 — the first woman, first Black American, and first South Asian American to hold the office.
